title: workflow saves a row once while its calls emit, audit and write provenance — the version moves once and every tail is delivered

apiCaller.//: The workflow run and the entity-history read are not-lifted route classes (workflow route, audit history).

mikroorm.//: The workflow's inline audit row is written through the drizzle schema, which the mikroorm adapter does not emit.
mikroorm.reason: a workflow calling an audited op imports `../db/schema`, absent under mikroorm, so the server does not boot

dotnet.//: An audited call inside a workflow records the row as it stood after that call, where the golden records the row as finally saved; the snapshot's lineage keys are PascalCase (#5969).
dotnet.reason: the .NET audit `after` of an audited call in a workflow is the per-call row, not the saved one

dapper.reason: the .NET audit `after` of an audited call in a workflow is the per-call row, not the saved one

java.//: An audited operation called inline from a workflow writes no audit row.
java.reason: an audited op called from a workflow body records no audit_records row

python.//: An audited operation called inline from a workflow writes no audit row.
python.reason: an audited op called from a workflow body records no audit_records row
